capabilities: Order notes on a timeline or number line by a numeric property
Drag, drop, and resize notes to edit their property values
Create new notes by double-clicking a position on the timeline
Filter the view with Obsidian search syntax
disambiguation: Not a calendar or daily-planning view; the axis can be any numeric property, not just dates.
extras: README includes a roadmap; vertical layout, manual vertical positioning, embeds, and mobile support are not yet implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view for arranging notes visually along an axis based on a property value.
summary: Timeline visualization view that orders notes on a timeline or number line by a chosen numeric property.
